title: Platform views cannot be embedded in the widget tree
flutter_ref: rendering/platform_view.dart:76-684 (RenderAndroidView, RenderUiKitView, RenderAppKitView, RenderDarwinPlatformView, PlatformViewRenderBox); rendering/layer.dart:1005 (PlatformViewLayer); services/platform_views.dart:72 (PlatformViewsService)
incular_ref: MISSING: rg -n -i 'platform_view|PlatformView|AndroidView|UiKitView' crates returned no hits
evidence: Flutter places a native view as a render object in the widget tree (AndroidView, UiKitView, AppKitView) that participates in layout, clipping and hit testing. No Incular type, layer or service exists for it, so a Flutter app that embeds a native view has no Incular equivalent.
impact: Apps that need a native map, web view or camera preview inside an Incular layout cannot place it there; they must composite it outside the Incular tree.
cause: Incular's compositor (incular-rendering) and widget tree model only Incular-drawn content; native embedding is not modelled.
fix_direction: Decide whether native view embedding belongs in the native host crates (incular-android, incular-ios, incular-macos) with a placeholder layer in incular-rendering; it is a platform API, not a renderer-neutral one.
limitations: Source-only: no scenario, because the API does not exist. Whether this is a planned gap is a product decision, not verified.

title: Predictive back progress is not delivered to routes
incular_ref: MISSING: rg -n -i 'predictive|back_event|BackEvent' crates found only a doc comment at crates/incular-material/src/page_transitions.rs:28
evidence: Flutter's predictive back events carry progress, swipe edge and touch offset from the Android back gesture, which route transitions and PopScope use to animate the back gesture. Incular has no equivalent event type; the only mention is a doc comment in the material page transitions.
impact: On Android with predictive back enabled, Incular routes cannot follow the system back gesture progressively; back is presumably all-or-nothing from the app's point of view.
cause: The Android host (incular-android) does not forward a predictive back event into the runtime, and navigation has no progress channel.
fix_direction: Add a platform-neutral back-progress event in incular-platform/incular-navigation and map the Android back callbacks in incular-android; route transitions can then consume progress.
limitations: Source-only. Not verified against an Android device; it is possible the Android host handles back elsewhere (not searched beyond the crates tree for these names).

title: Text fields have no platform undo manager integration
incular_ref: MISSING: rg -n 'UndoManager|undo' crates found only Incular's app-level undo (crates/incular-runtime/src/lib.rs, crates/incular-runtime/tests/undo.rs), not a platform undo stack
evidence: Flutter's UndoManager bridges text editing undo and redo to the platform undo stack, for example the Apple responder-chain Cmd+Z. Incular's undo is an application history, not a bridge to the system undo manager.
impact: System undo and redo gestures and menu items may not act on text edits in Incular text fields on platforms where Flutter wires them.
cause: No platform undo client is registered for text editing; the editing model in incular-text does not expose an undo client.
fix_direction: Owned by the text package: expose an undo client from the text editing session and forward platform undo/redo commands in the native host crates.
limitations: Source-only. Whether the native host forwards system undo commands by another route was not checked; reassigned to text, which owns editing.

title: Spell check service is not integrated with text fields
incular_ref: MISSING: rg -n 'SpellCheck|spell' crates found no spell-check service type; matches were incidental (incular-web/src/text_input.rs, incular-platform/src/lib.rs, incular-controls/src/styles.rs)
evidence: Flutter asks a spell check service for suggestions and renders misspelled words through the text span builder (widgets/spell_check.dart, owned by the text package). Incular has no service interface and no suggestion span type.
impact: Text fields cannot show spelling underlines or suggestions through the framework; apps would need custom text rendering to do this.
cause: No spell check service or suggestion span is modelled in incular-text or incular-widgets.
fix_direction: Owned by the text package. Add a platform-neutral spell check result type and a suggestion span consumed by the text span builder; native spell check can then be provided by the host.
limitations: Source-only. The text package's own audit row for buildTextSpanWithSpellCheckSuggestions (coverage/text.jsonl) remains the authoritative place for the widget-side behavior.

title: NetworkAssetBundle has no counterpart
incular_ref: MISSING: rg -n 'NetworkAssetBundle' crates returned nothing; bundles are MemoryAssetBundle and DirectoryAssetBundle (crates/incular-assets/src/bundle.rs:95, :140)
evidence: Flutter can load assets over HTTP (NetworkAssetBundle) and from the platform's manifest (PlatformAssetBundle). Incular bundles are in-memory or directory bundles only.
impact: Apps cannot load assets from a URL through the asset bundle API; images through the bundle need a custom AssetBundle implementation.
cause: Only local bundle sources were implemented in incular-assets.
fix_direction: Add a network-backed AssetBundle implementation in incular-assets or the web host, if network assets are wanted; a platform manifest bundle is not needed because bundles are compiled in.
limitations: API-shape and feature gap; no runtime divergence was observed because no scenario was built. Users can implement AssetBundle themselves, which is a partial mitigation.
